stages.objective: Prove one reviewed external source can traverse immutable acquisition to corpus eligibility without weakening held-out isolation.
acceptance_evidence: One exact source_id/source_version with immutable snapshot URI, byte size and SHA-256.
Durable rights decision is APPROVED_FOR_TRAINING with explicit model-training permission and non-NOASSERTION license state.
All accepted records carry PASS metadata for quality, language, PII and copyright hooks; unresolved hook status fails closed.
D06 benchmark-registry manifest is imported by exact manifest SHA-256 and injected reserved source/content contamination is rejected.
Deterministic shard plan and resume manifest reproduce identical plan/manifests on repeated LOCAL_FREE execution.
Exact corpus eligibility manifest binds source-registry identity, record count, normalized bytes and streamed metadata SHA-256.

stages.objective: Exercise multi-source Parquet/fsspec staging plus exact and near-dedup mechanics on reviewed snapshots.
acceptance_evidence: At least three immutable source versions pass independent source-rights eligibility checks; zero unresolved source versions enter training.
Parquet/fsspec staging is executed from immutable snapshots with output manifests bound to exact source/registry identities.
Partitioned exact-dedup emits survivor and duplicate evidence with deterministic content-hash partitioning and tie-break rules.
Pinned DataTrove MinHash pipeline executes on synthetic duplicate/near-duplicate fixtures and records its exact DataTrove version and plan hash.
Near-dedup injection fixture demonstrates expected duplicate removal without treating semantic similarity as legal or rights approval.
Policy metadata coverage is 100% for quality, language, PII and copyright categories on train-eligible records.

stages.objective: Prove restartable bounded-memory corpus construction across a larger immutable multi-source candidate.
acceptance_evidence: Remote/object-store fsspec reads and writes use credential-free canonical metadata URIs and immutable source hashes.
Injected interruption followed by resume skips only content-addressed completed shards and yields identical final shard hashes.
Peak-memory and throughput measurements are captured for sharding, exact-dedup and MinHash mechanics at representative synthetic cardinality.
Training candidate has zero source-ID and exact-content overlap against the exact D06 reserved-registry identity used by evaluation.
Corpus candidate manifest binds source registry, rights/policy gate, dedup plans, contamination report and shard/resume identities.

stages.objective: Prepare an auditable corpus-freeze candidate; do not freeze or promote it inside this package.
acceptance_evidence: Every included external source has a complete immutable provenance and rights dossier with durable reviewer/policy references.
Exact D06 benchmark/evaluation identities and fingerprints are frozen for the corpus candidate before decontamination evidence is generated.
Exact-dedup and scalable near-dedup reports are bound to the same corpus candidate identity and retained as artifacts.
Deterministic sharding/rebuild/resume evidence reproduces exact final shard hashes from the exact source snapshot set.
AUDIT-B independently retests the exact corpus candidate and issues its own verdict; this backlog does not self-approve or self-promote.
Any materially paid corpus-processing compute has separate explicit authorization; absent authorization, only LOCAL_FREE evidence is valid.
